dialogues.jp:
ファミレスを出た俺達は、肩を並べて桜公園を
歩いた。
dialogues.en:
We exited the family restaurant, and walked side-by-side
through the Sakura Park.
dialogues.text:
We exited the family restaurant, and walked side-by-side
through the Sakura Park.

dialogues.jp:
桃色に薄く霞む花は雲のようで、頬を撫でるぬ
るい風と相まり、なんともいえない和やか気分
にさせてくれる。
dialogues.en:
The atmosphere was peaceful, with a haze of sakura petals
brushing against our cheeks.
dialogues.text:
The atmosphere was peaceful, with a haze of sakura petals
brushing against our cheeks.

dialogues.jp:
タダ飯の満足感からか、映画館で恥かいたこと
も、野郎二人というこの状況も、別にどうでも
いいやと思えてくる。
dialogues.en:
Despite the embarassing situation at the movie theater, the
satisfaction of a good meal made this outing not a total
loss.
dialogues.text:
Despite the embarassing situation at the movie theater, the
satisfaction of a good meal made this outing not a total
loss.

dialogues.jp: ぴらぴら舞う桜の下で満足の溜息。
dialogues.en: I sighed in satisfaction under the dancing sakura petals.
dialogues.text: I sighed in satisfaction under the dancing sakura petals.

dialogues.jp: 男二人の道中もさして悪いものじゃないな。
dialogues.en: It isn't bad at all for two guys to go out together.
dialogues.text: It isn't bad at all for two guys to go out together.

dialogues.jp:
……いやむしろヘタに女が入ってくるより、こ
のほうが気が置けなくていいかも。
dialogues.en:
...Of course, if it was a girl in his place, I wouldn't even
be thinking about something like this.
dialogues.text:
...Of course, if it was a girl in his place, I wouldn't even
be thinking about something like this.

dialogues.jp:
ちらりと横を見ると、はらはらと舞い落ちる花
弁を手の平にうける工藤の姿。
dialogues.en:
I glanced at my side at Kudou, who was letting the sakura
petals fall onto his palm.
dialogues.text:
I glanced at my side at Kudou, who was letting the sakura
petals fall onto his palm.

dialogues.jp:
無邪気そうなその横顔は、なんだかミョーに可
愛らしい。
dialogues.en: Such an innocent smile... he really looks kinda cute.
dialogues.text: Such an innocent smile... he really looks kinda cute.

dialogues.jp: （……いや、その形容詞は正しくないな）
dialogues.en: "(...No no no, that isn't right.)"
dialogues.text: "(...No no no, that isn't right.)"

dialogues.jp: なーにを考えているのやら、
dialogues.en: What the hell am I thinking about.
dialogues.text: What the hell am I thinking about.

dialogues.jp: やれやれと俺は苦笑を漏らした。
dialogues.en: I let myself smile exasperatedly.
dialogues.text: I let myself smile exasperatedly.

dialogues.jp: 「……やっぱ、日本男児なら桜だよな〜」
dialogues.en: "...In a way, Japanese men are just like sakura~"
dialogues.text: "...In a way, Japanese men are just like sakura~"

dialogues.jp:
ちょっと怪しげな思考に入った己を戒めるが如
く、日本『男児』という箇所を強調しつつ言う。
dialogues.en:
As a weird thought made it's way into my mind, I made sure
to emphasize the "man" part.
dialogues.text:
As a weird thought made it's way into my mind, I made sure
to emphasize the "man" part.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「まぁた『日本男児なら』か」
dialogues.en: "Not that "Japanese Man" schtick again."
dialogues.text: "Not that "Japanese Man" schtick again."

dialogues.jp:
ファミレス店員前にしての演説がよほど頭に残っ
ているのか、工藤は俺を眺めてくすくすと笑っ
た。
dialogues.en:
Remembering my speech during our meal, he goaded me in a
teasing manner.
dialogues.text:
Remembering my speech during our meal, he goaded me in a
teasing manner.

dialogues.jp:
これもまた、桜花の見せる魔法か……その笑顔
はなにやら妙に愛くるしい。
dialogues.en:
I seemed to be detecting a hint of affection in his smile...
msut be the magic of the sakura.
dialogues.text:
I seemed to be detecting a hint of affection in his smile...
msut be the magic of the sakura.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「でも、俺はどっちかっていうと葉桜のほうが
　好きかな」
dialogues.en:
"But actually, I prefer sakura trees while they're still in
leaf."
dialogues.text:
"But actually, I prefer sakura trees while they're still in
leaf."

dialogues.jp:
指先にとまった桜の花弁を｛もてあそ／弄｝びながらひとりご
とのようにつぶやく工藤。
dialogues.en:
He happily played with a sakura petal that had landed on his
fingertip, as if no one was watching.
dialogues.text:
He happily played with a sakura petal that had landed on his
fingertip, as if no one was watching.

dialogues.jp: 「……そういう奴も珍しいな」
dialogues.en: "...That's a pretty rare opinion around here."
dialogues.text: "...That's a pretty rare opinion around here."

dialogues.jp:
さすがに見飽きた万年桜の風景とはいえ、やは
り桜、といったら満開や散り際の花を指すもの
だと思っていたが。
dialogues.en:
Admittedly, most people, having seen falling sakura petals
so often, get tired of it quickly.
dialogues.text:
Admittedly, most people, having seen falling sakura petals
so often, get tired of it quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そっか？」
dialogues.en: "Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so?"

dialogues.jp:
小首をかしげて指先の花弁をふっと吹く。白い
花弁は小さな小さな蝶のようにひらひらと空中
を舞い落ちていった。
dialogues.en:
The wind blew the sakura petal on his fingertip away. It
danced like a tiny butterfly, before falling to the ground.
dialogues.text:
The wind blew the sakura petal on his fingertip away. It
danced like a tiny butterfly, before falling to the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「だって桜の葉の緑色ってすげぇ｛すがすが／清々｝しいじゃ
　ん。新緑、って言葉がぴったりな感じでさ」
dialogues.en:
"The green of the sakura leaf then is really good to look
at. It's refreshing, you could say."
dialogues.text:
"The green of the sakura leaf then is really good to look
at. It's refreshing, you could say."

dialogues.jp:
確かにそういわれればそうかもしれない。椿や
椎の木のようにくすんだグリーンとは違う色だ。
dialogues.en:
That's a pretty valid reason. The green of a sakura tree is
quite different than those of most other trees.
dialogues.text:
That's a pretty valid reason. The green of a sakura tree is
quite different than those of most other trees.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「五月病になりかけた時に葉桜見ると『よし、
　もうちょっと頑張るか』って気分になれるん
　だよ」
dialogues.en:
"Even during the gloom of the start of a new school year,
looking at sakura trees in leaf make you feel like working
harder."
dialogues.text:
"Even during the gloom of the start of a new school year,
looking at sakura trees in leaf make you feel like working
harder."

dialogues.jp:
まぁ｛ここ／初音島｝では、そうそうお目にかかれないん
だけどね、と少し寂しげに工藤は微笑んだ。
dialogues.en:
Well, here, it's hard for that to happen... and his sad
smile showed that he knew it himself.
dialogues.text:
Well, here, it's hard for that to happen... and his sad
smile showed that he knew it himself.

dialogues.jp: 「そうだな……」
dialogues.en: "I guess..."
dialogues.text: "I guess..."

dialogues.jp:
一年中、桜の花の枯れることないこの島で葉桜
を見る事はない。
dialogues.en:
Since the sakura petals haven't withered for over a year
now, the island hasn't seen sakura trees in leaf since.
dialogues.text:
Since the sakura petals haven't withered for over a year
now, the island hasn't seen sakura trees in leaf since.

dialogues.jp:
でもまぁ、なんとなく、なんとなくだがその気
持ちは分からなくもなかった。
dialogues.en:
So somehow or other, most of us have lost all knowledge of
that feeling.
dialogues.text:
So somehow or other, most of us have lost all knowledge of
that feeling.

dialogues.jp:
さわさわと風が流れていく。俺たちは黙って桜
の木を見上げた。
dialogues.en:
The wind quietly died down. We quietly looked up at the
sakura trees.
dialogues.text:
The wind quietly died down. We quietly looked up at the
sakura trees.

dialogues.jp:
だが、次の瞬間、工藤の口から漏れた言葉は、
そんなしんみりとした雰囲気を一気に吹き飛ば
すものだった。
dialogues.en: And in a single sentence, Kudou swept away the solemn mood.
dialogues.text: And in a single sentence, Kudou swept away the solemn mood.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「それに、桜の葉って桜餅を連想させるし」
dialogues.en:
"And, it's hard to make sakuramochi without the sakura
leaf."
dialogues.text:
"And, it's hard to make sakuramochi without the sakura
leaf."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ？」
dialogues.en: "Haah?"
dialogues.text: "Haah?"

dialogues.jp:
気が抜けた俺は思わず間抜けな声をあげてしま
う。
dialogues.en:
Thrown for a loop, all I could utter was a stupid
exclamation.
dialogues.text:
Thrown for a loop, all I could utter was a stupid
exclamation.

dialogues.jp: 人をあれだけしんみりさせておいてその発言。
dialogues.en: That killed the entire mood.
dialogues.text: That killed the entire mood.

dialogues.jp: この男、あなどれん……。
dialogues.en: This guy, seriously...
dialogues.text: This guy, seriously...

dialogues.jp:
正直、工藤の口からそんな言葉が出るとは、夢
にも思わなかった。
dialogues.en:
The way this guy talks, I can't believe he has any sort of
romanticism...
dialogues.text:
The way this guy talks, I can't believe he has any sort of
romanticism...

dialogues.jp:
まさに『花より団子』か……桜を見て和菓子を
思い出すとは……見かけに依らず食い意地の張っ
た奴だ。
dialogues.en:
Seeing such beautiful sakura petals, then thinking of how
well they go on a certain food.
dialogues.text:
Seeing such beautiful sakura petals, then thinking of how
well they go on a certain food.

dialogues.jp: （……しかし、なんだな）
dialogues.en: "(...Still, what was that all about.)"
dialogues.text: "(...Still, what was that all about.)"

dialogues.jp: 妙に親近感が沸いた。
dialogues.en: We were practically bonding then until...
dialogues.text: We were practically bonding then until...

dialogues.en: --*Whoosh*
dialogues.text: --*Whoosh*

dialogues.jp: そのとき、あたりに一陣の風が巻き起こった。
dialogues.en: At that moment, a gust of wind rolled up again.
dialogues.text: At that moment, a gust of wind rolled up again.

dialogues.jp: 工藤が小さく叫んで顔を押さえる。
dialogues.en: Kudou put his head down with a short yell.
dialogues.text: Kudou put his head down with a short yell.

dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「目に……砂入ったみたいだ」
dialogues.en: "My eye... some sand got into it."
dialogues.text: "My eye... some sand got into it."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あ、待て。こすらないほうがいい」
dialogues.en: "Ah, calm down. Don't cross your eyes."
dialogues.text: "Ah, calm down. Don't cross your eyes."

dialogues.jp: 目を押さえようとする工藤を制止する。
dialogues.en: Kudou ended his struggle with his eyes.
dialogues.text: Kudou ended his struggle with his eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「どれ、見せてみ」
dialogues.en: "Let me take a look."
dialogues.text: "Let me take a look."

dialogues.jp: 俺は工藤の頬に手をかけ、瞳を覗き込んだ。
dialogues.en:
I placed my hand on Kudou's cheek and turned his face
towards me, peering into his eye.
dialogues.text:
I placed my hand on Kudou's cheek and turned his face
towards me, peering into his eye.

dialogues.jp:
ほとんど触れそうなくらいまで、顔と顔が近づ
く。
dialogues.en:
As I tried to find the grain of sand, our faces got closer
and closer.
dialogues.text:
As I tried to find the grain of sand, our faces got closer
and closer.

dialogues.jp: どん！
dialogues.en: *Don!*
dialogues.text: *Don!*

dialogues.jp: 突然胸を押されて、俺はぐらりとよろけた。
dialogues.en:
I felt a strong force on my chest, almost causing me to fall
backwards.
dialogues.text:
I felt a strong force on my chest, almost causing me to fall
backwards.

dialogues.en: "Whoa, whoa...."
dialogues.text: "Whoa, whoa...."

dialogues.jp:
なんとか腕を廻して、バランスを取り、こける
ことだけは避けられた。
dialogues.en:
I reacted quickly, regaining my balance, and managed to not
fall onto my ass.
dialogues.text:
I reacted quickly, regaining my balance, and managed to not
fall onto my ass.

dialogues.jp:
「あ、あぶねぇなぁ、もうちょっとでコケると
　こだっただろ！？」
dialogues.en: "T, that was dangerous! Did you want me to fall down!?"
dialogues.text: "T, that was dangerous! Did you want me to fall down!?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「わ、悪い。その……ちょっと、びっくりした
　もんだから」
dialogues.en: "I, I'm sorry! I was just... a bit surprised."
dialogues.text: "I, I'm sorry! I was just... a bit surprised."

dialogues.jp:
しどろもどろになって答える工藤の頬は何故か
真赤に染まりあがっていた。
dialogues.en:
Kudou's answer was flustered, and his cheeks were glowing
red for some reason.
dialogues.text:
Kudou's answer was flustered, and his cheeks were glowing
red for some reason.

dialogues.jp: 「……ま、それはいいから。見せてみろって」
dialogues.en: "...Well, whatever. I'd look again."
dialogues.text: "...Well, whatever. I'd look again."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫、自分で取れるからっっっ」
dialogues.en: "It's fine, I'd remove it myself!"
dialogues.text: "It's fine, I'd remove it myself!"

dialogues.jp:
工藤は近づこうとする俺に向かってぶんぶん首
を振る。
dialogues.en:
He shook his head vigourously as I started walking closer
again.
dialogues.text:
He shook his head vigourously as I started walking closer
again.

dialogues.jp: 「変な奴だな……」
dialogues.en: "You're a strange one..."
dialogues.text: "You're a strange one..."

dialogues.jp: なにをそんなに慌ててるんだろう……。
dialogues.en: What's there to be scared about...?
dialogues.text: What's there to be scared about...?

dialogues.jp:
こそこそと背を向ける工藤の後ろ姿を眺めて俺
は首をひねった。
dialogues.en:
I stretched and continued walking, looking back occasionally
to make sure Kudou was there.
dialogues.text:
I stretched and continued walking, looking back occasionally
to make sure Kudou was there.

dialogues.jp:
たらたらと歩きながら、俺の家の前まで帰って
きた。
dialogues.en: After some more walking, we reached my house.
dialogues.text: After some more walking, we reached my house.

dialogues.jp:
「じゃあな、工藤。今日は意外と楽しかったぞ、
　誘ってくれてありがとな」
dialogues.en:
"Thanks for today, Kudou. It was... unexpectedly
entertaining."
dialogues.text:
"Thanks for today, Kudou. It was... unexpectedly
entertaining."

dialogues.jp: 門に手をかけながら、俺は工藤に礼を言った。
dialogues.en: With one hand on the gate, I thanked him.
dialogues.text: With one hand on the gate, I thanked him.

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、お前から電話がなきゃ、一日だらだらっ
　と過ごしてただろうしな」
dialogues.en:
"Heh, thanks to your call, the whole day has passed by so
quickly."
dialogues.text:
"Heh, thanks to your call, the whole day has passed by so
quickly."

dialogues.jp:
本当に――午後になってから出かけたとは思え
ないほど、充実した日であった。
dialogues.en:
Honestly-- when I woke up this afternoon, I didn't think my
day would be so full of entertainment.
dialogues.text:
Honestly-- when I woke up this afternoon, I didn't think my
day would be so full of entertainment.

dialogues.jp:
普段、俺の中では杉並＆工藤で１セットという
形なので、あまり工藤と二人っきりでどこかに
行くとかいうことはなかったのだが、
dialogues.en:
Normally, Kudou, Suginami and I come in a set, so I've not
spent much time with just Kudou alone.
dialogues.text:
Normally, Kudou, Suginami and I come in a set, so I've not
spent much time with just Kudou alone.

dialogues.jp: なかなかどうして、楽しかった。
dialogues.en: Somehow, it was really quite fun.
dialogues.text: Somehow, it was really quite fun.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そう言ってもらえれば何よりだ」
dialogues.en: "What're you trying to say by that?"
dialogues.text: "What're you trying to say by that?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「また何かあったら、誘ってくれよ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, if anything similar happens again, feel free to
invite me."
dialogues.text:
"Well, if anything similar happens again, feel free to
invite me."

dialogues.jp: そして、俺はにやりと笑って付け足した。
dialogues.en: Smiling, I added a bit more.
dialogues.text: Smiling, I added a bit more.

dialogues.jp: 「勿論、メシはお前の｛おご／奢｝りでな」
dialogues.en: "Naturally, the meal will be your treat."
dialogues.text: "Naturally, the meal will be your treat."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ズーズーしい奴だな、もう」
dialogues.en: "Thinking with your stomach as always, sigh."
dialogues.text: "Thinking with your stomach as always, sigh."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ははは、ま、それは冗談として、独り者同士
　｛ぶりょう／無聊｝を慰め合おうや」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha, just kidding, but if you ever need company..."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha, just kidding, but if you ever need company..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「口に出すなよ、余計に侘びしくなる」
dialogues.en: "Enough already, you're scaring me."
dialogues.text: "Enough already, you're scaring me."

dialogues.jp: そう言いながらも工藤は楽しげに笑っていた。
dialogues.en: He laughed lightly with his speech.
dialogues.text: He laughed lightly with his speech.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあな、新学期に本校で会おうぜ」
dialogues.en:
"Well then, when school resumes, we'd meet at the main
school. Later!"
dialogues.text:
"Well then, when school resumes, we'd meet at the main
school. Later!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "See you."
dialogues.text: "See you."

dialogues.jp:
軽く手を挙げて去っていく後姿をしばらく眺め
て、俺は門を閉めた。
dialogues.en: With one final wave, I opened the gate.
dialogues.text: With one final wave, I opened the gate.

dialogues.jp: ◆男二人組◆
dialogues.en: ◆Two Good Men◆
dialogues.text: ◆Two Good Men◆

dialogues.jp:
ファミレスを出た俺と工藤は桜公園を抜け家路
についた。
dialogues.en:
We exited the family restaurant, and walked through the
Sakura Park on the way home.
dialogues.text:
We exited the family restaurant, and walked through the
Sakura Park on the way home.

dialogues.jp:
午後から出かけたとは思えないくらい有意義な
一日であった。
dialogues.en:
When I woke up this afternoon, I didn't think my day would
be so full of entertainment.
dialogues.text:
When I woke up this afternoon, I didn't think my day would
be so full of entertainment.
